sentences.en: But often in architecture, what looks the best is at odds with what sounds the beSt.

sentences.en: Of course, you don't necessarily want to always see the big black speakers somewhere.

sentences.en: And so we have to get creative.

sentences.en: We like our speakers out of sight.

sentences.en: And we also like high ceilings and long glass windows, which make spaces sound really reverberant.
sentences.zh: 我们还喜欢高天花板和长条玻璃窗，这会让空间听起来有很强的混响。

sentences.en: So architecture is a puzzle for Ashley and her team to solve.
sentences.zh: 因此，建筑对于阿什利和她的团队来说是一个需要解决的谜题。

sentences.en: Whenever we see rooms that have curved walls, we kind of cringe, especially if they're out of glass.

sentences.en: When we approach spaces, there are things that, although they're beautiful,

sentences.en: we know are going to definitely put pressure on us to come up with creative and unique ways
sentences.zh: 但我们知道，它们肯定会给我们带来压力，让我们必须想出富有创意且独特的方法，

sentences.en: to appease the visual and sonic needs of the room.
sentences.zh: 来满足该房间在视觉和声学上的需求。

sentences.en: So it depends on what you're trying to do in that space.
sentences.zh: 所以这取决于你试图在这个空间里做什么。

sentences.en: If it's a venue for the symphony or the opera, you want the sound to be big and resonant and echoing.
sentences.zh: 如果它是一个交响乐或歌剧的演出场所，你会希望声音宏大、饱满且带有回声。

sentences.en: For a cafe or a place with acoustic performances, a little reverb is nice.
sentences.zh: 对于咖啡馆或有声学表演的地方，一点混响是不错的。

sentences.en: But if you're trying to hear a lecture or a reading or, say, have a meeting, you probably don't want much reverb at all.
sentences.zh: 但如果你是要听讲座、朗读，或者比方说开会，你可能根本不希望有太多混响。

sentences.en: But we haven't always been able to precisely control the acoustics of a building.
sentences.zh: 但我们并非一直能够精确控制建筑物的声学效果。

sentences.en: Sound, until fairly recently, was a somewhat mysterious element in architecture.
sentences.zh: 直到不久以前，声音在建筑学中还是一个多少有些神秘的要素。

sentences.en: In the late 18th century, there are all sorts of different theories about how to get good sound,
sentences.zh: 在18世纪末，有各种各样关于如何获得好声音的理论，

sentences.en: but half of them contradict the other half, and no one really knew what to do.
sentences.zh: 但其中一半与另一半相矛盾，没有人真正知道该怎么做。

sentences.en: She's a history professor at Princeton and a scholar of sound technology.
sentences.zh: 她是普林斯顿大学的历史学教授，也是声音技术学者。

sentences.en: And she says at the turn of the 20th century, architectural acoustics are pretty much a roll of the dice.
sentences.zh: 她说在20世纪之交，建筑声学基本上就是靠碰运气。

sentences.en: Architects begin to fret that they don't really know what they're doing with this aspect of their designs.
sentences.zh: 建筑师们开始感到苦恼，因为他们真的不知道自己在设计的这一方面在做什么。

sentences.en: And it was all kind of left to chance.
sentences.zh: 这一切都只能听天由命。

sentences.en: And if you were lucky, your theater would sound good.
sentences.zh: 如果你运气好，你的剧院听起来就会很好。

sentences.en: And if you were unlucky, it wouldn't.
sentences.zh: 如果你运气不好，就不会好。

sentences.en: And in 1895, Harvard University was very unlucky.
sentences.zh: 而在1895年，哈佛大学的运气非常不好。

sentences.en: The university had just completed building the Fogg Art Museum,
sentences.zh: 该大学刚刚建完福格艺术博物馆，

sentences.en: and it had a lecture hall where there was so much reverberation that they simply could not hold classes in that room.
sentences.zh: 里面有一个演讲厅，混响大到他们根本无法在该房间里上课。

sentences.en: You couldn't understand the speaker because there was so much reverberate confusion.
sentences.zh: 由于混响带来的混乱太严重，你根本听不懂演讲者在说什么。

sentences.en: Harvard had just wasted a lot of money on a completely useless room.
sentences.zh: 哈佛在这样一个完全无用的房间上浪费了大量金钱。

sentences.en: And in an attempt to save the space,
they enlisted the help of a rookie physics professor who had some time on his hands.
sentences.zh: 他们寻求了一位空闲时间较多的年轻物理学教授的帮助。

sentences.en: So the president of Harvard asked this young physics professor
sentences.zh: 于是哈佛校长请这位年轻的物理学教授

sentences.en: to figure out how to fix that auditorium and make it usable teaching space.
sentences.zh: 想办法修复那个礼堂，使其成为可用的教学空间。

sentences.en: This professor's name was Wallace Sabine.
sentences.zh: 这位教授名叫华莱士·萨宾。

sentences.en: And through this task, Sabine would eventually become the father of architectural acoustics.
sentences.zh: 通过这项任务，萨宾最终成为了建筑声学之父。

sentences.en: This sent Wallace Sabine onto an investigative path that actually took several years collecting data.
sentences.zh: 这让华莱士·萨宾踏上了一条实际上花费了数年时间收集数据的调查之路。

sentences.en: Basically making sounds in rooms and timing the reverb.
sentences.zh: 基本上就是在房间里制造声音并计算混响时间。

sentences.en: He would take measurements of the different reverberation times in different rooms all over campus.
sentences.zh: 他会测量校园里各个房间的不同混响时间。

sentences.en: And in order to do this under the quietest possible circumstances,
sentences.zh: 为了在尽可能安静的环境下做到这一点，

sentences.en: he tended to run his experiments in the middle of the night.
sentences.zh: 他倾向于在半夜进行实验。

sentences.en: And he would change the reverberation time within a given room
sentences.zh: 他会通过把各种吸音材料搬进特定的房间，

sentences.en: by bringing into it various sound-absorbing materials.
sentences.zh: 来改变该房间内的混响时间。

sentences.en: He threw out over 3,000 measurements after determining that his own clothes
sentences.zh: 在确定他自己的衣服对房间声音有一点微小影响后，

sentences.en: had a small effect upon the sound of the room.
sentences.zh: 他扔掉了三千多份测量数据。

sentences.en: He started all over again, taking measurements in the dead of night,
sentences.zh: 他重新开始，在深夜进行测量，

sentences.en: but now wearing the exact same outfit every time.
sentences.zh: 但现在每次都穿着完全相同的衣服。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, the president of Harvard is waiting and waiting for this lecture hall to be made useful again.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，哈佛校长一直在等待这个演讲厅重新变得可用。

sentences.en: At one point, he finally says to the young professor,
sentences.zh: 有一次，他对这位年轻教授说，

sentences.en: it's time for you to tell us what to do here.
sentences.zh: 是时候告诉我们这里该怎么做了。

sentences.en: And that night, feeling nervous under pressure,
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，在压力下感到紧张的萨宾

sentences.en: a mathematical relationship between the size and materials of a room in its reverberation time.

sentences.en: A relationship so steady that you can make a formula out of it.

sentences.en: So that then you can take any sort of architectural plan,
